verdict.rationale: Retell documents a transcription-mode setting that trades off latency vs accuracy (interim vs context-aware results) and lets developers pick the language model, but there is no evidence of choosing among multiple STT providers or specifying custom key terms/vocabulary. Community threads show real-world transcription/understanding glitches (misheard dates, loops, contradictions), suggesting accuracy isn't guaranteed. missing for 10: explicit STT provider selection, custom key-term/vocabulary boosting, independent benchmark of transcription accuracy.
